class_guess: hierarchical binary counter: #33/#11's counter whose u=1 digits freeze into fossil-K walls with decrementing fuel (= #32's table, D-start)
summary: #32's table, D-start: #11's counter plus nested walls whose fuel drops 1 per lower overflow; no proof idea yet.
mechanism: Level 1 is #33's / kill #11's binary counter (carry M_k, same formula, 12,350/12,350 exact to 3e8). One cell differs (B1 0RD vs 0RE): a carry reaching a bit-1 digit with u = 1 turns back and does a partial overflow P (#32's rule, exact).

P leaves misaligned text that acts as a fossil K-block wall (01)^w 000 (01)^x with a slow level-2 counter behind it. Each level-1 overflow lowers the wall gap by exactly 1 (217 at 1.8e7, 179 at 2.8e8, 151 at 2e10); a far wall (gap 52-53) sits at the end. Halting needs A> 111.

Fuel cut to 9 or 5 in a real config: the wall dissolves, the far wall keeps burning, new walls form with fresh fuel (109, 164); no halt to 2e8. 54 of 12,438 macro steps to 3e8 still have no rule (far-end terminators, the wall's v = 1 shape, Z3 junctions), as for #32.

rules.name: M_k carry (= #33's M_k)
rules.cases: needs a >= 1, v >= 1, every trailing digit uj >= 2 and vj >= 1; S never read. v = 1: the digit drops (fuses). 300 random (k = 0..5, sizes to 300) + all 12,350 M steps of the real run to 3e8. Control: one trailing uj = 1 -> formula fails 60/60

rules.name: P partial overflow at the first u = 1 digit (#32's P, mirrored)
rules.cases: k = m-p+1 digits, up = 1, ui >= 2 (i > p), a >= 1, S starts with 1 and S' = S minus that 1; p = m: ... (01)^vm 10 S'. 300 random (k = 1..5) + all 34 P steps of the real run to 3e8

rules.name: O full overflow (= #33's O), all u >= 2, bare 1001 end
rules.cases: a >= 1, all uj >= 2. Never fires from blank to 3e8 (the far end is never the bare 1001). Control: one uj = 1 -> fails 200/200 (P happens instead)

rules.name: wall fuel law (empirical, real run only)
rules.from: reset that ends at the inner wall W(L), shape Z2 0 O2 | O2 0 Z2 | Z3
rules.to: inner wall W'(L-1), next shape in the cycle
rules.cases: all 38 resets from 1.8e7 to 2.84e8 (L 217 -> 179); 2e10 sample L = 151. Not a formula yet; not tested on random instances

template.module: our kill #11 (machines/1RB0LE_1RC0RC_1LD0RB_1LA0LE_1LD1LF_1LD---/, check_kill PASS); same table as pool #32 (OPEN)
template.diff: 1 transition after mirror + renaming (#11's A,B,C,D,E,F = R4's B,C,D,A,E,F): #11 A1 0LE vs 0LC here (= R4's B1 0RE vs 0RD). With that change the table is exactly #32's; R4 starts in #32's D
template.note: M and O carry over verbatim when every digit has u >= 2. #11's INV does not survive: u = 1 digits appear right away (O's new MSB digit (0,0,u1) flips to u = 1), P replaces O, and the fossil walls are outside #11's family. #32 hit the same wall (notes there). SBCv6 TM21 / TCv3 are loose relatives only.

strategy: Joint with #32 (same table). Model one level as K-block + digits + fossil K-block, get exact rules for the 3 open event types and the fuel law, then find a recursive invariant (each level a counter whose wall fuel is refilled when a new wall forms). Constructed small-fuel runs first.
risks: Recursive structure: walls form, burn fuel and dissolve; a proof needs a multi-level invariant, which is far beyond a delta of #11.
54 of 12,438 macro steps (3 event types) have no rule yet; #32 hit the same ones.
The long-run regime is unobservable: inner-wall fuel 151 at 2e10, burning at slowing rate.
